title: “EVERYTHING”: The Black Skirts’ album ending and Japanese introduction

blocks.text: Listeners heard the planned ending of The Black Skirts’ third album more than a year before the album arrived. Released on January 29, 2016, “EVERYTHING” was explicitly introduced as an advance single intended for the record’s final slot. Its place in the sequence was already part of its public story. [Original release notes](https://www.genie.co.kr/detail/albumInfo?axnm=80780854); [TEAM BABY release record](https://www.genie.co.kr/detail/albumInfo?axnm=80951471).

The Black Skirts is songwriter Jo Hyu-il’s solo project, and the single credits him with lyrics, composition and arrangement. It was also his first release after joining HIGHGRND. The promotional notes anticipated a third album that year; TEAM BABY eventually appeared on May 30, 2017, with “EVERYTHING” tenth and last. The timetable had changed, but the intended position held. [Contemporaneous Melon feature](https://m.melon.com/cds/musicstory/mobile2/musicstory_view.htm?mstorySeq=3227); [single notes and credits](https://www.genie.co.kr/detail/albumInfo?axnm=80780854); [album sequence](https://www.genie.co.kr/detail/albumInfo?axnm=80951471).

Jo later described TEAM BABY to Kstyle as a soft-rock album about love, with enough variety that he hoped any listener could find a song they liked. For someone arriving through “EVERYTHING”, his description offers a reason to explore the surrounding record: the album approaches that shared subject through several genres. [Kstyle interview, syndicated by Livedoor](https://news.livedoor.com/article/detail/20961774/).

On June 30, 2021, “EVERYTHING (Japanese Ver.)” became his Japanese debut single. Asked by Kstyle why he chose it, Jo said it was his most-loved song and one he personally liked. In his account, listeners’ affection and his own attachment made an established song the choice for a new introduction. [Japanese release announcement](https://sensa.jp/news/20210630-tbs.html); [Kstyle interview](https://news.livedoor.com/article/detail/20961774/).

The familiar song nevertheless presented an unfamiliar task. In his release-day statement, Jo said this was his first time singing in Japanese. Pronunciation initially felt awkward, and he took particular care to make the emotional expression feel natural. His account locates the work of returning to “EVERYTHING” in how he could convey it in another language. [Artist statement published by SENSA](https://sensa.jp/news/20210630-tbs.html).

The Japanese-language TEAM BABY followed on September 29, 2021, retaining “EVERYTHING” as its tenth and final track. Both release sequences therefore offered the same possible route: encounter the song on its own, then return to it at the album’s end. Its role as an introduction coexisted with the closing position announced back in 2016. [Japanese album details](https://news.livedoor.com/article/detail/20961774/); [original single notes](https://www.genie.co.kr/detail/albumInfo?axnm=80780854).
